rules.text: A planet gives, above all, the results of its star lord: the houses that star lord occupies and owns. The sign it sits in only shows how strong the planet is, not what it gives.
Of the star lord’s houses, the one it occupies comes first; the houses it owns come second. Both act, but occupation is stronger.
If no planet stands in the stars of a planet, that planet gives the results of its own houses directly.
The planet is the source, its star lord shows what kind of matter comes, and its sub lord decides whether the matter turns out well or badly for the native.
Two planets in the same star can give opposite results. The star lord names the object; the sub lord shows whether it is gained or given up.
No planet is wholly good or bad: judge it for one matter at a time. The 6th, 8th and 12th houses counted from any house work against that house, so count from the house of the matter or relative.
A good star with a bad sub gives no fruit. A star of the lord of 6, 8 or 12 with a good sub gives only a little relief, in the sub lord’s period.
A planet that owns one good and one bad house does not cancel out: it gives gains in some sub-periods and losses in others. Do not split its period into a good half and a bad half.
Relatives are read from their own house taken as the ascendant: mother 4, father 9, child 5, younger sibling 3, partner 7. Count every other house from there; the native’s periods stay the same.
Twins born minutes apart share the planets but not the cusp subs. So what differs in their lives must come from the cusps and their sub lords, which is why the cusp sub lord decides.
Tradition, and KP before 1967, also judged houses from the Moon sign. Krishnamurti’s later ruling: always use the ascendant alone, because twins share the Moon but not the cusps.
Tradition holds that Jupiter and Venus are benefics and the lords of 6, 8 and 12 malefics. Krishnamurti rejects fixed labels: a planet is good or bad only for a given matter, by its star and sub.
Tradition promises wealth and rank from Raja and wealth yogas. Krishnamurti finds they often fail, so their presence guarantees nothing; judge by star and sub lords instead.
Tradition fears Sade Sati, Saturn’s seven and a half years around the Moon. Krishnamurti calls it a “meaningless slogan”: what Saturn gives depends on its star and sub lords.
Tradition says a planet in the 11th always does good and the 8th from the Moon is always bad. Krishnamurti rejects such blanket rules: the star lord and sub lord of the planet decide.
Cancer ascendant: planets in the 5th or 9th seldom give good periods, because the star lords there rule 6, 8 or 12. Planets in Mars’s stars do well even from the 3rd, 8th or 12th.
Libra ascendant: Saturn, lord of 4 and 5, is the best planet for this ascendant. Planets in Saturn’s stars give the matters of the 4th and 5th houses.
Virgo ascendant: planets in Mercury’s stars give the matters of the 1st and 10th houses, which is very good for this ascendant.
The ascendant sub lord signifies the 1st house itself. It is the key to keeping good health, resisting infection and succeeding in one’s own efforts.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 2. Money comes in: one takes up service, the bank balance grows and hard work pays.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 3. Good mental growth. Knowledge grows through frequent short trips; brothers, neighbours and relatives are close and helpful.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 4. Well educated and studious. Gains from land, estates and mines, help from ancestral property, and an interest in occult study.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 5. Great delight in sport, speculation and pleasures; deeply attached to one’s children.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 6. Health needs care: resistance is low and recovery slow. Fond of pets, close to the maternal uncle and to servants; wins lawsuits and elections.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 7. Open enemies fade away. Union and partnership: benefit through the spouse or partner, and a happy married life.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 8. Money from legacy, gratuity, bonus, insurance or arrears of pay; one saves money, may work for others, and has occult or mediumistic experiences.

rules.topic: Father, fortune, higher learning and abroad
rules.text: The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 9. Fond of the father and of long journeys. Religious, philosophical, drawn to science and research; graduates may earn a doctorate. Gains through in-laws.

The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 10. Honour, awards and prestige. One rises to a high social and professional position and becomes known to the public; very good for business and public life.
The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 11. Large profits and many benefactors; hopes and wishes are fulfilled and “failure out of question”. Prosperity, contentment and children’s marriages.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The ascendant sub lord signifies houses 1 and 12. Troubles, jealousy, secret enemies and hindrances; liable to be cheated and to be one’s own undoing. Likes yoga, solitude and occult study; invests rather than banks money.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 1 and 2: money comes easily through one’s own effort, in service or business, and the bank position improves.
Service rather than business: the 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 1, 2 and 6, or signifies the 10th without the 7th.
Business rather than service: the 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 1, 7 and 10.

The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 3. Gains through education, writing, publishing, journalism, publicity, agencies, commission and touring sales; help from brothers and colleagues. Lucky for one’s children.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 4. Inherits estates and money; keen to own land and buildings and gains by such investment. Success in one’s own place; vehicles and transport.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 5. Gains through music, cinema, sport, entertainment, young people and children. Lucky for children and mother.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 6. Profit in any transaction; easy overdrafts; gains from elections, pets, poultry, medicine, public health, service work and labour. Good for children.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 7. Gains through a partner or by marriage, through contracts and dealings with others; success in litigation and seniority kept.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 8. Gains by legacy, insurance, bonus, gratuity or a will.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2, 8 and 9: money can be lost through a bank failure.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2, 8 and 11: gain from legacy, insurance or gratuity is certain.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 9. Money through export and import, books, long journeys, foreigners, patents, religion and science, or the partner’s relatives.

The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 10. Steady progress and lasting prosperity: Government service or business, honours and a growing reputation. Children do well in service and examinations.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 11. Money without much effort: gains from speculation and lottery-like windfalls, and friends oblige.
The 2nd cusp sub lord signifies houses 2 and 12. Money from serving in a hospital, sanatorium, asylum, jail or circus, or from occult work. Not good for children.
Mercury is the 2nd cusp sub lord, which colours the speech: one talks a lot and well; suits an agent, salesman or representative.
Mars is the 2nd cusp sub lord, which colours the speech: one speaks bluntly and frankly.
Saturn is the 2nd cusp sub lord, which colours the speech: one speaks little and slowly.
Jupiter is the 2nd cusp sub lord, which colours the speech: one speaks wisely.
Venus is the 2nd cusp sub lord, which colours the speech: one enjoys talk with and about the other sex.
The lord of the 12th is in the 8th: one can clear debts easily in that planet’s periods.
The 3rd cusp sub lord is in a dual sign, or in the star of a planet in a dual sign: one has several brothers or sisters. KP gives no rule yet for their number or sex.
The 3rd cusp sub lord is in the star of Jupiter placed in the 11th, or Mars in the 11th is aspected by Saturn: worry comes through brothers and sisters.
Venus is the 4th cusp sub lord. The nature of this sub lord shows what a building one owns is used for; Venus points to cinema, music or entertainment.
The 4th cusp sub lord is in the star of a significator of the 4th and is connected with Venus: one will surely own a vehicle.
The lords of the 4th and 9th are both in the sub of a significator of the 11th: education is successful.
Mars, Mercury or Jupiter signifies houses 4, 9 and 11: success in competitive examinations.
A planet in the 4th is in the star of the 6th lord or of a planet in the 6th: this links study with the 6th, and with the 11th it shows a scholarship or a free place.

rules.topic: Father, fortune, higher learning and abroad
rules.text: The 9th cusp sub lord is in the 11th: the wish for higher study is fulfilled and efforts succeed.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The 12th cusp sub lord is in the 8th, the 12th from the 9th: this works against going overseas.
The 10th cusp is in Taurus, Moon’s star, Saturn’s sub: trade in petrol and oils.
The 10th cusp is in Taurus, Moon’s star, Mercury’s sub: trade in cotton and silk goods.
The 10th cusp is in Leo, Venus’s star, Jupiter’s sub: law and education, as an advocate or educationist.
The 10th cusp is in Leo, Sun’s star, Sun’s sub: the medical profession.
The 10th cusp is in Aries, Venus’s star (Bharani), Jupiter’s sub: animal husbandry or veterinary work, or a judge.
The 10th cusp is in Aries, Venus’s star (Bharani), Saturn’s sub: work in a slaughter house, or trade in hides, skins and footwear.
The 10th cusp is in Aries in the sub of the Sun: a surgeon, including a veterinary surgeon.
The 10th cusp is in Aries, Ketu’s star (Aswini), Saturn’s sub: a butcher or meat trade.
The 10th cusp is in Aries, in Aswini or Bharani, Venus’s sub: a barber or beauty trade.
The 10th cusp is in Gemini, Mars’s star, Sun’s sub: a surgeon; otherwise mechanical engineering, Government service or a Government press.
A significator of houses 2, 6 or 10 is in the 3rd house in a dual sign: the job is a transferable one, with tours and transfers.
Saturn in the 10th: a rapid rise followed by a fall deeper than the height climbed. It also draws one to holy places, life abroad or renunciation.
Sun in the 7th: a steady business with small ups and downs. In KP its star lord decides the outcome.
Moon in the 7th: frequent changes in the line and place of business; income is very unsteady. In KP its star lord decides the outcome.
Mars in the 7th: rash, impulsive business moves that bring loss, such as overpaying at auctions. In KP its star lord decides the outcome.
Mercury in the 7th: quick turnover and larger profits in business. In KP its star lord decides the outcome.
Jupiter in the 7th: honest dealing; the business grows and thrives. In KP its star lord decides the outcome.
Venus in the 7th: good luck and popularity in business. In KP its star lord decides the outcome.
Saturn in the 7th: very bad for business. In KP its star lord decides the outcome.
A planet in the 7th is in the star of the lord of 2, 10 or 11: business succeeds.
A planet in the 7th is in the star of the lord of 8 or 12: bad for business, whatever the planet.
